propositions: A portable public-API surface drift gate using pure-stdlib introspection (inspect/importlib) captures live surface against a committed baseline JSON and fails on removed/renamed symbols or changed signatures when run via make test

The gate introspects a pinned MODULES list (rebar facade and documented reuse subsystems) extracting public members via __all__ or owned non-underscore attributes, storing callable signatures, class bases, dataclass fields, and pinned immutable constant values in JSON baseline

The hardcoded-subset signature assertions from test_reuse_surface_doc.py are removed and subsumed by the new baseline with no coverage loss, proved by subsumption tests for signing, prompts, runner, and workflow-executor symbols

An intentional API surface change is accommodated by the --update flag (written as committed baseline JSON) and validated by test that stale baseline fails --check but passes after re-running --update
The gate detects added, removed, and parameter-renamed public symbols by injecting drift and verifying --check exits non-zero with clear remediation message naming the drift type
